catalog.name: Cloudmark
catalog.summary: Bookmarks without an account: create a collection with a write token, save pages with a bookmarklet or the Chrome extension, and open them from any device. On D1.
catalog.tagline: Save bookmarks and open them from any device

vars.name: BASE_URL
vars.label: Public URL
vars.help: The public address where visitors open this app.

postInstall.content: Open {{appUrl}}/doc, create a collection (its `mark`) and write token, and drag the bookmarklet to your bookmarks bar. Your bookmarks are at {{appUrl}}/<mark>. Keep the write token: anyone with it can change the collection.
Anyone who can open {{appUrl}} can create collections of their own, and anyone who knows a `mark` can read that collection. Only the write token allows changes.
